requirement: The system shall refuse to issue a course completion certificate when the learner has not completed every mandatory lesson in the course.
The system shall compute a learner's course progress percentage as the number of completed lessons divided by the total lesson count.
The learner enrols in a course; the system verifies prerequisite completion, records the enrolment and unlocks the first module.
The learner opens a lesson; the system loads the lesson content, marks the lesson as started and records the start time for reporting.
As a learner, I want to resume a course where I last stopped so that I do not have to find my place again.
As an instructor, I want to publish a new lesson in a course so that enrolled learners can access it immediately.
A quiz submission may only be accepted if the learner has not already exceeded the maximum number of attempts for that quiz.
Every learner progress change (start, complete, quiz submission, certificate) must be recorded with the affected entity, the previous state, the new state and the time.
The lesson progress table shall ensure that a learner may not have two records for the same lesson, that the position is non-negative and that the status is from the recognised set.
code:
-- lesson progress table
CREATE TABLE lesson_progress (
    progress_id            BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    learner_id             VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    lesson_id              VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    course_id              VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    status                 VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    last_position_seconds  INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    started_at             TIMESTAMP,
    completed_at           TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at             TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT progress_unique UNIQUE (learner_id, lesson_id),
    CONSTRAINT progress_position_nonneg CHECK (last_position_seconds >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT progress_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('NOT_STARTED','STARTED','COMPLETED')),
    CONSTRAINT progress_completed_needs_start CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR started_at IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE INDEX progress_learner_course_idx ON lesson_progress (learner_id, course_id, status);
hard_negatives:
-- course table
CREATE TABLE course (
    course_id      VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    title          VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    instructor_id  VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    pass_mark      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    lesson_count   INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT course_pass_mark_range CHECK (pass_mark BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    CONSTRAINT course_lesson_count_nonneg CHECK (lesson_count >= 0)
);
-- quiz attempt table
CREATE TABLE quiz_attempt (
    attempt_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    learner_id    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    quiz_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    score         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    passed        BOOLEAN     NOT NULL,
    submitted_at  TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT attempt_score_range CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
);

requirement: Only the enrolled learner may view their own progress; instructors may view progress of learners enrolled in their courses; other users must be denied.
The nightly analytics job shall produce a per-course summary of active learners, average completion percentage and the number of certificates issued in the last day.
